name: notify_job_receiver
label: Notification Task Receiver Table
description: The notification task receiver table is used for related queries in framework-related scenarios and report queries.

fields.name: notify_job_id
fields.description: Notify task ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: receiver
fields.description: Receiver, group, role UUID or email, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The receiver type should distinguish whether it's an email, user, group, or role's UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: receive_type
fields.description: Receiver type, to: recipient; cc: CC, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the notify_job_id, receiver, type, receive_type fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.
